title.en: New article: When AI Chip Geopolitics Dictate Our Monthly Server Bills

body.id: Satu tulisan baru ditambahkan ke blog: "Ketika Geopolitik Cip AI Menentukan Tagihan Server Kita". Tulisannya membahas dinamika regulasi semikonduktor global dan dampaknya terhadap harga sewa gpu serta strategi pengembang ai di indonesia Artikel terbaru: "Windows Loudness EQ di PipeWire dan Pelajaran untuk AI Audio".
body.en: A new article was added to the blog: "When AI Chip Geopolitics Dictate Our Monthly Server Bills". It covers how global semiconductor regulations and supply chain friction directly hit cloud compute costs for local software teams Latest article: "Windows Loudness EQ in PipeWire and Lessons for Audio AI".
